concerns.text: Section 1 of research.md states that human feasibility scores will be collected for **all 1 000 prompts** (\"Collect human feasibility scores for **all 1 000 prompts** (FR‑001 & FR‑009 reconciled)\"), while the specification (FR‑009) only requires scores for **at least 200 prompts**. The power analysis (Section 7) assumes 500 conflicting samples with human scores, yielding >0.8 power. If only 200 prompts receive human annotations, the paired test will be under‑powered, violating the claimed statistical power and potentially leading to false‑negative conclusions. The plan must reconcile the annotation coverage requirement with the power analysis, either by ensuring human scores for the full 1 000 prompts or by adjusting the sample size/power calculations accordingly.
